title: Act2Intention: A Benchmark For Developing Active Mobile Agents Through Inferring User Intention from GUI Actions
abstract: arXiv:2608.14132v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mobile GUI Agents powered by multimodal large language models (MLLMs) show promise in human-computer intelligence. However, current research primarily focuses on reactive task execution while lacking a comprehensive understanding-prediction-execution process for user intentions, which are the core requirements of active agents. In this paper, we propose the Act2Intention framework that builds an active mobile agent by integrating understanding, predicting user intentions, and executing decisions. First, we construct the Act2Intention Bench through data collection and validated generation, comprising 72,511 intentions and over 700,000 actions across 52 apps, thereby establishing the first benchmark for evaluating proactive agents via continuous intention-action trajectories. We further develop the Act2Intention Agent, achieving proactive services through Proactive-oriented Intention Understanding, Personalized Proactive Intention Predic

translated_title: Act2Intention：一个通过从GUI操作推断用户意图来开发主动移动代理的基准
translated_abstract: 由多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）驱动的移动GUI代理在人机智能方面展现出潜力。然而，当前研究主要侧重于响应式任务执行，缺乏对用户意图的全面“理解-预测-执行”过程，而这正是主动代理的核心需求。在本文中，我们提出了Act2Intention框架，通过整合理解、预测用户意图和执行决策来构建主动移动代理。首先，我们通过数据收集和验证生成构建了Act2Intention Bench，包含52个应用中的72,511个意图和超过700,000个操作，从而建立了首个通过连续意图-操作轨迹评估主动代理的基准。我们进一步开发了Act2Intention代理，通过面向主动的意图理解和个性化主动意图预测实现主动服务。
tldr: 本文提出了Act2Intention框架和基准，首次通过从GUI操作推断用户意图来构建和评估主动移动代理，涵盖52个应用中的72,511个意图和70万+操作。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Act2Intention framework and benchmark, which for the first time builds and evaluates proactive mobile agents by inferring user intentions from GUI actions, covering 72,511 intentions and over 700,000 actions across 52 apps.
